title: 2.9 Controlling Microorganisms
description: Physical, chemical and behavioural methods used to kill or inhibit microbes. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Sterilisation?
options: The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces
Heating liquids briefly to kill harmful microorganisms
The ability of a microbe to withstand a control method
The complete removal or killing of all microbial life
questions.correctAnswer: The complete removal or killing of all microbial life

questions.question: What is Disinfection?
options: A chemical applied to living tissue to inhibit microbes
Practices that prevent contamination by unwanted microbes
A substance added to food to prevent microbial spoilage
The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces
questions.correctAnswer: The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces

questions.question: What is Antiseptic?
options: The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces

A substance added to food to prevent microbial spoilage
A chemical applied to living tissue to inhibit microbes
questions.correctAnswer: A chemical applied to living tissue to inhibit microbes

questions.question: What is Antibiotic?
options: Slowing microbial growth by keeping food at low temperatures
A device that uses pressurised steam to sterilise materials
A compound produced by microbes that inhibits other microbes
Removing microbes by passing a liquid through a fine filter
questions.correctAnswer: A compound produced by microbes that inhibits other microbes

questions.question: What is Antibacterial?
options: An agent that suppresses the replication of viruses
Using high temperatures to kill all microbial forms
An agent that kills or stops the growth of bacteria
Stopping microbial growth by turning water into ice
questions.correctAnswer: An agent that kills or stops the growth of bacteria
